options_compared.reason: Task-0 BDDL/instruction and domain differ; mixing task families would confound task-count effects with task definition and source distribution.

The published LeRobot v3 dataset reports an 8-D observation.state schema, whereas the validated current native pipeline consumes 15-D state. Adopting it would require a state/preprocessor adaptation and would no longer be the controlled current pipeline.

Preserves the historical native task family and can use tasks 0-3 with their official BDDL/instructions. Before any training, verify task-0 byte/provenance compatibility, identical observation/action schema, task mapping, episode counts, matched per-task sample exposure, and evaluator task support.

read_only_gpu_inventory.implication: Do not start 4-task training from the currently present custom32 dataset; first source a matching official native LIBERO-Spatial HDF5 suite and validate it.

proposed_experiment_if_preflight_passes.comparison_baseline: existing current-pipeline native task0 run: 10000 updates x batch 8 = 80000 task0 sample draws; fixed init 5/5 and paired 20-init 12/20

proposed_experiment_if_preflight_passes.evaluation: same native evaluator, task-specific language/BDDL, identical fixed initialization manifest and rollout settings; preserve per-task per-initialization records

preflight_before_training: Verify official source, license, archive integrity, and enough disk space before download.
Check official task-0 BDDL/instruction/HDF5 schema against the already validated 50-episode native task-0 dataset; do not silently substitute if it differs.
Select exactly 50 episodes for each of tasks 0-3 and compute frozen train/evaluation manifests with no overlap.
Convert to a new LeRobot dataset root; verify images, 15-D states, 7-D actions, task_index/task text, finiteness, and exact sample counts with the current training loader.
Run a no-gradient balanced-loader smoke test proving each batch has exactly two examples per task and total per-task draws match the plan.
Validate same evaluator and strict deterministic settings on all four native tasks; do not treat expert replay as policy success.
Check GPU idle, configuration uniqueness, adequate disk, and nonexistence of all new output paths immediately before launch.

safety.github_hf_payload_policy: publish code, README, lightweight JSON only; no checkpoint, raw HDF5, Parquet, videos, or logs
